channel.title: Grok Bot Changelog
channel.description: New features, improvements, and fixes in each Grok Bot release

item.title: Main Bot and more reliable updates (0.66.0)
item.description: New Choose a primary Bot, marked Main Bot with a star, that checks in proactively and coordinates work with your other Bots; requires Grok Bot 0.59.0 or later. Improved In Slack threads, the Bot's status line shows what it's working on and stays up during long steps. Teams Fixed Update downloads resume after your computer sleeps, and on Mac a copy running from a disk image or Downloads offers Move to Applications. A Bot that hangs on an unresponsive command or computer stops itself with a note, and your next message picks up where it left off. Your phone notifies you about each Bot reply only once, and never for Bot chats you've deleted.

item.title: Team Bot voice chat and automatic updates (0.65.0)
item.description: New Teammates can start a voice chat with a Team Bot, and the call stays in their own conversation with it. Teams Improved Automatic Updates is on by default, so Grok Bot restarts to apply updates while you're away; turn it off in Settings → Updates. Your phone skips notifications for a Bot you're viewing on your computer, and resumes them once the computer locks, sleeps, or sits idle. Team Bot setup goes card to card with no Bot messages in between, and each card shows its step, like Step 2 of 5. Teams Fixed When you connect an app, sign-in shows why it failed or that its link expired, and Reopen or Retry starts a fresh sign-in.

item.title: Team Bot managers and refreshed avatars (0.64.0)
item.description: New Email and Slack draft cards offer Disable drafts for this Bot, so that Bot sends messages directly; ask the Bot to turn drafts back on. The creator of a published Team Bot can add teammates under Managers, who can then change its profile, skills, plugins, secrets, and Slack app. Teams Improved Bot avatars have a refreshed look with bigger eyes, and the avatar editor adds square, sparkle, clover, flower, heart, house, and star shapes. Links in Bot messages show the site's icon next to the underlined link text. When a Bot needs a login or other form filled, its chat card opens a Secure Form window showing the site's name and icon.

item.title: Slack approvals and faster browsing (0.63.0)
item.description: New In Slack threads, a Bot that needs your approval posts a Review an action card only you can answer, instead of dropping the action. Teams You can ask a Team Bot in Slack to message one of your own Bots, and the reply comes to you privately in Grok Bot. Teams Improved Adding a plugin that needs sign-in, such as Gmail, from Marketplace starts its sign-in right away instead of stopping at Added. Bots move through websites faster, with shorter waits for pages to settle after each click or form submission. Marketplace focuses on plugins: Featured Bots and Bot search results no longer appear, and the search box reads Search plugins. A Team Bot you own that's ready to publish shows Publish at the top of its details pane, replacing the Publish to team card. Teams Fixed Grok Bot signs in and connects on networks with a TLS-inspecting proxy, using root certificates installed on your computer. When you use up your plan's included usage, Grok Bot shows the usage limit notice instead of Bot failed to respond. After a Bot says it's on your request and does the work, it sends you the result instead of going quiet. Settings → Usage & Billing shows your included usage and when it resets, instead of saying your plan has none. A Bot keeps the voice, speed, and language you set for it instead of resetting them to the defaults. In the Tasks tab of a Bot's details pane, deleted or expired cloud agent runs leave the Coding list, and stalled statuses show Status unavailable. A Bot you create while the app is open shows its latest message preview and unread dot in the sidebar right away. Team Bots with names Slack rejects, such as emoji or non-Latin names, can still be added to Slack under a Slack-safe name. Teams

item.title: Quotes, lists, and spell check (0.62.0)
item.description: New Select text in a chat and press Cmd/Ctrl+L, or choose Add to prompt, to quote it in your next message. Type - or 1. to start a bulleted or numbered list in the composer; Shift+Enter adds an item, Tab nests it, and Enter still sends. Grok Bot underlines misspelled words as you type and offers suggestions and Add to Dictionary on right-click; turn it off with Check Spelling While Typing. On the Manage Team Bots page in the dashboard, team admins can search by Bot or creator name and delete a teammate's Team Bot. Teams Improved A Bot's info pane has a Library tab listing the pages, files, and links it has shared, grouped into Today, This week, and Older. When 1Password isn't connected, Bots ask for site logins with a form in the chat, offering Connect 1Password only if you have the app. A Team Bot's info pane shows how many plugins, secrets, skills, and files it has, and a Publish to team card once it's ready. Teams When your Slack workspace needs admin approval, the Add to Slack dialog asks you to Send request in Slack before showing Awaiting admin approval. Teams Fixed When a Bot asks you to connect an app in chat, it resumes the task on its own once you finish signing in. A message that didn't go through shows Failed to send with Resend and Delete, instead of being stuck on Not delivered yet. Desktop and phone notifications arrive as soon as a Bot sends a message, instead of only when it finishes working. Emails a Bot sends through Gmail go to the recipients it names, not to a saved draft's original recipients. Deleted Bots free their screens on the shared computer, so other Bots' browser actions no longer fail because every screen is taken. When a Bot sends several images to Slack, every image is posted, not just the first. A Bot stays signed in to websites when its computer's browser restarts.

item.title: Team Bots (0.61.0)
item.description: New Team Bots let you publish one Bot for your whole team, and teammates chat with it in the app or Slack, each in their own conversation. Teams Choose Publish to Team in a Bot's Share menu to make a team copy with its chat and memories, or Start fresh; your original Bot stays private. Teams A new Team Bot walks you through plugins, secrets, skills, and files one card at a time, and only you can see it until you choose Publish to team. Teams Owners edit a Team Bot's name, description, plugins, secrets, skills, files, and Slack app from its details, and Unpublish takes it away from teammates. Teams Teammates find Team Bots under Team Bots in New chat, see the ones they add in the sidebar, and get a greeting with Try asking suggestions. Teams A Team Bot asks before using your connected plugins; Always allow covers that Bot or every Team Bot until you choose Clear connector preferences. Teams Teammates' use of a Team Bot counts against their own allowance, and the Bot keeps private notes for each person across the app, Slack, and routines. Teams Team Bots work in Slack: they reply in threads, read channels they've joined, answer workflow mentions, start new posts, and keep links, code, and tables intact. Teams Ask a Team Bot in Slack to set up, change, pause, or delete your routines; link your Slack account under Settings → General → Team Bots. Teams Team admins can add a Team Bot for the whole team or chosen groups from Manage team bots on the dashboard, and members can't hide it. Teams Fixed Files a Bot says it's sending you reach the chat more reliably instead of silently going missing.

item.title: Outlook drafts and more reliable replies (0.60.0)
item.description: New Editable email drafts work with Outlook: review a Bot's new email in chat, then choose Send email to send it from your Outlook account. Improved The sidebar's Marketplace button is now Connect apps, with logos of featured plugins beside it. Wide tables in Bot messages keep their full layout in narrow windows and scroll sideways instead of squeezing into tall columns. Emoji reactions on messages arrive with a short animation that pops the emoji into place. Fixed Bots reply more reliably instead of ending a turn silently, including after using tools or when background work you're waiting on finishes. Bot messages show real line breaks and quotation marks instead of stray backslashes, and links at the end of a line open the right page. If an unpaid invoice or a plan without Grok Bot stops a Bot's reply, the app and Slack say why instead of a generic error. Searching for a Bot by name in New chat, Search, or @mentions finds Bots whose names contain what you typed, with exact matches first. When the image provider declines an avatar description, the avatar editor explains why and suggests rewording it. Creating a Bot from New chat reliably opens the new Bot instead of sometimes stalling after it's created.

item.title: Team Secrets and a centered layout (0.59.0)
item.description: New Expired Auto-review cards offer Always allow this in the future, so you aren't asked about that action again. Admins can store Team Secrets on the Grok Bot dashboard, and Team Setup scripts receive them as environment variables. Enterprise Improved When you message a busy Bot, it answers you before working through queued updates from other Bots, Cloud Agents, and background tasks. On wide windows, chats and the message box stay in a centered column, and wide tables in replies can stretch across it. Hitting a usage or spend limit shows the full limit banner, with buttons like Upgrade, Set Spend Limit, or Request Upgrade to ask your admins. Bots use built-in guides with direct links and steps for popular travel, food, shopping, and shipping sites. Fixed When you send several messages in quick succession, the Bot answers all of them, including the first. Bots with a lot of saved memory or skills reply without a several-second pause, and save and forget memories reliably. Bot replies in long chats stay visible instead of flickering in and then disappearing when you open or reload the chat. When the Bot's computer is briefly unreachable or an automatic computer update fails, chat keeps working without interrupting you with a dialog. On Windows, a downloaded update installs when you quit, and on macOS, a failed update install is retried instead of keeping the old version.

item.title: New languages, sidebar, and accessibility (0.58.0)
item.description: New You can choose Czech, Danish, Finnish, Hungarian, or Norwegian Bokmål under Language in Settings, and Follow System selects them when your computer uses one. With Terminate Inactive Computers on, members' Grok Bot computers are terminated after 30 days without use. Enterprise Improved Search and New chat are round buttons atop the sidebar, Marketplace sits in its footer, and the Bot's name in the chat header opens conversation details. Grok Bot reconnects faster after sleep or a network change, and brief reconnects or computer updates no longer put a banner across the window. Action Recording logs more Bot activity, including tool results and handoffs to subagents and cloud agents, and redacts card numbers and access tokens. Enterprise Screen readers announce more of the app, including suggestions, new questions, and message authors, and keyboard focus is visible and stays inside full-screen viewers. Fixed When a Bot can't reply because of a usage limit, rate limit, or timeout, the chat shows a card that says why. Anyone with Grok Bot access can play a Bot's voice memos without being asked to upgrade their plan. Auto-review rules you add while a Bot is working, such as with Always allow, stay saved. If you hang up a voice chat while a Bot is still working on your request, it finishes and posts the result in the chat. A Bot can use a plugin whose only connected account has a label, such as a labeled Outlook account. The sidebar keeps your Bots in the same order through reloads and relaunches, and opening a Bot leaves it in place. Voice chats use the microphone you choose under Microphone in Settings, and fall back to your default microphone if it's unavailable. Bots reconnect to your local computer after a reboot instead of reporting that it isn't connected.

item.title: Projects and richer link previews (0.57.0)
item.description: New A Bot can start a Project when you ask for one: a Cloud Agent that plans the work and runs its own agents. Improved Link cards and previews show real titles for private Notion pages, GitHub issues and pull requests, and Slack messages using your connected accounts. While a Bot's voice memo plays, its transcript highlights each word in sync with the audio, and clicking a word jumps playback there. Hidden Bots is a collapsible section at the bottom of the sidebar, and a hidden Bot's menu offers Show in sidebar to bring it back. Messages you send show as sent right away, and a small progress bar appears only if one takes over two seconds to reach the Bot. A Bot's sidebar menu drops Edit Profile, Duplicate, and template items; use View conversation details to edit the profile and the share menu for templates. Audit Logs record more Grok Bot activity, including computers, group chats, templates, skills, plugins, routines, and deleting or sharing a Bot. Enterprise Fixed Bots reply to questions they can answer from their own knowledge instead of sometimes stopping without replying. A Bot's browser stays connected when other Bots on the same computer use theirs, waits longer for slow pages, and reconnects if it drops. A Bot's Waiting for you status in the sidebar clears once it's no longer waiting, instead of getting stuck. A Bot's sidebar preview shows its latest message even when it's a form, photo, widget, or approval request, instead of going blank.

item.title: GitHub, spreadsheets, and clearer approvals (0.56.0)
item.description: Improved Bots can work with GitHub releases, tags, labels, sub-issues, discussions, and collaborators, create branches, and submit one pull request review covering several files. Review an action cards say in one sentence what the Bot wants to do and keep the command and reasoning behind View the full request. Spreadsheet previews let you select cells and ranges, move with the arrow keys, copy with Cmd/Ctrl+C, and show up to 10,000 rows. When you tell a Bot to stop, it also stops the other Bots it handed work to and the Cloud Agents it started. Fixed Marketplace shows plugin changes, such as connecting, disconnecting, removing, or signing in, as soon as they finish. Routines that watch a single GitHub pull request run only for events on that pull request. Changing a Bot's avatar shape and color applies every pick right away, even when you click through them quickly. One-time reminder routines show Once with their date and time. Bot computers that are asleep apply an admin's latest Network Controls when they next wake. Enterprise

item.title: Setup Checklist and form filling (0.55.0)
item.description: Improved The Grok Bot dashboard's Setup Checklist groups steps into Recommended and Optional and adds steps for plugins, Slack or Microsoft Teams, and network settings. Teams The About dialog shows when your copy of the app was built, and Copy version info includes the build date. Fixed Disconnect on the built-in GitHub plugin works even when your Grok Bot computer is unavailable or running an older version. When a Bot fills your answers from a chat form into a page, it also fills address and other fields that unlock only when clicked. On sign-in pages that keep fields filled while logging you in, the Bot checks whether a 1Password sign-in worked instead of handing you the screen.

item.title: Search, HEIC photos, and 1Password (0.54.0)
item.description: New Organization admins can choose Delete VMs and Data under Manage selected to remove members' Grok Bot computers along with their stored data. Enterprise Improved The search palette (Cmd/Ctrl+K) shows matching Bots, settings, actions, and routines before messages; wrap your search in quotes to see every matching message. A Bot you create from a template greets you in your app language instead of always in English. Fixed HEIC and HEIF photos, like those from an iPhone, show as images in the conversation, media viewer, and Media tab instead of as file attachments. Bots sign in with 1Password on more sites and let 1Password fill one-time codes and passwords instead of asking you to type them. The built-in GitHub plugin appears in Marketplace search with a Connect button, and its page lists its tools so you can turn each one off. Secret request cards say why a save failed and keep what you typed so you can try again.

item.title: 1Password, file uploads, and time zones (0.53.0)
item.description: New On a Mac, connect 1Password from the Marketplace so your Bot can sign in with your saved logins, asking you first unless you turn on Auto fill. Bots can upload files to Google Drive or OneDrive, or attach them to a Gmail draft. Improved Your Bot's computer uses your time zone, so websites and its clock match where you are. Click an open image to zoom in, and close the viewer with Escape, the close button, or a click outside the image. Fixed Stopping your Bot also stops anything still running on its computer. Bots fill sign-in fields even when they sit partly off the screen. Phone notifications show your Bot's picture. You can finish connecting Bitbucket from Grok Bot. A Bot created by another Bot now shows up in your sidebar.

item.title: GitHub connection and routine pausing (0.52.0)
item.description: New You can pause a routine and resume it later. Improved The built-in GitHub connection in the Marketplace shows whether your account is connected, with Connect GitHub when it isn't. Sidebar rows no longer show the time of the last message, and the collapsed sidebar has a Marketplace shortcut. Fixed Bots no longer send a second acknowledgment after they've already replied. Clicks and typing on your Bot's computer still work when Grok Bot can't check the page first. Scrolling sideways in a code block no longer slides the whole message. Your Bot's browser no longer offers to save passwords after it signs in. Approval cards close when their time runs out. Pressing Enter on Update ready restarts to update.

item.title: First Bot setup, routines, and scrolling (0.51.0)
item.description: New Setup now creates your first Bot for you. You can delete a routine, which also stops its future runs. Your Bot can change its own title and the shape and color of its avatar. Improved Each Bot reopens on the tab you last had open, even after a restart. Fixed Long conversations scroll all the way back, and you can drag the scrollbar to the top. A new account shows the Bot you created, and deleting your last Bot removes it from the list. Take over shows the screen your Bot is actually using.

item.title: Route web traffic through your computer (0.50.0)
item.description: New Turn on Route egress through this desktop in Settings to send web traffic from your Bot's computer through your own computer instead of the cloud. Fixed Requests to use your computer keep the command and details open, so you can read them before you answer.

item.title: Repository access, search, and file links (0.49.0)
item.description: New When your Bot needs access to a repository, a card lets you connect GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, or Azure DevOps, and the Bot continues once access is granted. Click a file path in a message to open that file from your Bot's computer. Improved Search shows everything in one list, with files, links, and routines appearing once you type. Pictures and videos open full screen, with download, close, and playback controls. Your Bot's computer keeps its browser sign-ins when it restarts. Teammates who aren't admins can invite people to Grok Bot. Teams Fixed Messages keep their paragraph and list line breaks. Connecting a service brings you back to Grok Bot, and a declined connection names the service. Muted Bots no longer add to the dock badge.

item.title: Multiple accounts and a new Marketplace (0.48.0)
item.description: New Add more than one account and switch between them from the account menu; each keeps its own Bots and data on this computer. Add a Bot straight from its row in the Marketplace. Enterprise admins with Conversation Insights see their team's top Grok Bot use cases on the Grok Bot page, with a link to the full breakdown. Enterprise Improved The Marketplace has one homepage for plugins and Bots, with featured picks, plugins popular with your team, and categories to browse. Marketplace search finds plugins, Bots, and categories as you type. Fixed Connectors that use an API key show Connected once they're connected. A link to a Bot that's no longer available says so, and Back returns to the Marketplace.

item.title: Usage & Billing and chat renaming (0.46.0)
item.description: New Right-click a chat to rename it. Improved Usage & Billing shows your weekly usage and plan, the chat warns you near your weekly limit, and you can set a monthly on-demand limit. Fixed Usage & Billing updates your on-demand limit when you come back from adding a payment method. Links in an email draft keep their wording when the message is sent. When your Bot's computer runs low on memory, closed browser tabs stay closed instead of all reloading. Leftover browser tabs no longer ask you to use a security key. Your Bot fills a sign-in form even when the page words its labels in a different order.

item.title: Email and Slack drafts, and admin Auto-review (0.45.0)
item.description: New Your Bot can write an email or Slack message as a draft for you to review, then Send or Discard it. Enterprise admins can require Auto-review and add team-wide Auto-Review Rules; members see it marked Required by your admin. Enterprise Improved After you submit a form, your Bot fills the visible fields, and a page change no longer makes you type them again. Fixed A new Bot introduces itself instead of leaving the chat empty. After you reset your Bot's computer, it's ready as soon as it reconnects, and anything you typed is still there. Bots read every message from your other Bots, even when several arrive while they're busy. Linux deb and rpm installs show when an update is available and tell you to update through your package manager.

item.title: Chat forms, timestamps, and AutoFill (0.44.0)
item.description: New When your Bot needs something like a sign-in, it asks with a form in the chat and fills the page for you, instead of handing you its computer. Hover over a message from your Bot to see when it was sent. On a Mac, right-click a text field to use AutoFill. Improved Requests to use your computer now appear in the chat. Before sending feedback for you, your Bot asks whether you'd like a reply from the support team. Fixed Tab inserts a tab in the message box, and multi-line pastes keep their indentation. Brief connection problems no longer sign you out or show your computer as disconnected. Videos and files from your Bot's computer no longer stop after the first 4 MB. When you're signed out, a connection problem no longer covers the sign-in screen.

item.title: Bots in the Marketplace and plugin setup (0.41.0)
item.description: New The Marketplace now lists Bots you can add as well as plugins, with categories, search, and a page for each Bot. Bots made by the Grok Bot team carry a Verified badge in the Marketplace. Improved While your Bot's computer connects, Connecting shows until the screen is ready. When Grok Bot access is limited to certain groups, invites explain that they don't grant access and link to Manage Access. Enterprise Fixed Plugin setup shows checkboxes, menus, and number fields when a plugin asks for them, and saved secrets appear as dots. Text you type while creating a Bot stays in that Bot's chat. Pull request links keep the words you wrote for them.

item.title: Enterprise access, languages, and Support menu (0.40.0)
item.description: New Grok Bot is now available to every Enterprise team, not only early-access organizations. Enterprise Grok Bot is available in Urdu, Thai, and Bengali. Audit Logs record when Bots are created, when Grok Bot access changes, and team setup changes. Enterprise Improved Help Center, Send Feedback, and About now sit under Support in the account menu, next to Get Grok Bot for mobile. Creating a Bot shows Creating… on its row while you stay in your current chat. Card requests say Approve, and a declined, failed, or expired request says no charge was made.

item.title: Vietnamese, Indonesian, and greetings (0.39.0)
item.description: New Grok Bot is available in Vietnamese and Indonesian. Improved A new Bot greets you in the language Grok Bot is set to. The Language list shows each language's name both in your current language and in its own. Plugin categories appear in your language. Reopening your Bot's computer keeps showing the last screen until it reconnects. Fixed Your Bots and their files stay put when your Bot's computer restarts while it can't read them. Pausing or deleting a routine also cancels runs that were waiting. The account menu keeps showing your weekly usage and accounts when a refresh fails. Follow System picks the right Chinese for Cantonese, Traditional or Simplified.

item.title: Group Access and sidebar names (0.38.0)
item.description: Improved Manage Group Access sits next to the switch that turns Grok Bot on, and group limits you save apply as soon as it's back on. Enterprise Fixed The sidebar keeps your name when your profile can't be loaded.

item.title: Setup choices, sharing menu, and follow-ups (0.37.0)
item.description: New Setup asks which tools you use every day, including Cursor. Enterprise admins see how many days are left in their Grok Bot trial on the dashboard Overview. Enterprise Improved Share as template, Update template, and View template details are in the share menu in the chat header. Fixed Your Bot's activity stays visible when you send a follow-up while it's still working. Chats you've already read stay read after an update. A Bot added from a template shows its name only once in the sidebar. Allow once works even when Execution on this computer is set to Never allow. Only one security-key prompt opens at a time, and closing it keeps it closed. Auto-review can ask you to approve Mac automation commands. Grok Bot works when your team limits who can use Cloud Agents.

item.title: Copy links, routine chats, and Always allow (0.36.0)
item.description: New Right-click a pull request in the chat to copy its link. Improved A routine's runs open in their own chat, and Close Chat brings you back. Fixed Always allow under Execution on this computer now lets your Bot use your computer without asking. Hide from sidebar hides every Bot you've selected.

item.title: Longer tasks, purchases, and shared Bots (0.35.0)
item.description: Improved Your Bot keeps working through long jobs and page-by-page browsing instead of stopping early. Team admins can send a link that opens Invite Your Team to Grok Bot. Teams Fixed Purchases you decline stay Declined, and unanswered ones are marked Expired. Opening a shared Bot again shows its latest version, including its integrations. Routines, feedback, and notifications stay on the team you selected.

item.title: Pull request previews and Bots in sections (0.34.0)
item.description: New Pull request links in messages show the number, title, and whether it's open, draft, merged, or closed. Your Bot can create a new Bot inside one of your sidebar sections. Improved Each routine on a shared Bot describes what it does instead of repeating its name. Fixed The New Bot shortcut closes Search first, so the two no longer stack. A Bot's avatar updates in the sidebar as soon as it changes. Approving an expired purchase asks for a fresh one, and a new purchase replaces one still waiting for an answer.

item.title: Group Access, team trials, and Link cards (0.33.0)
item.description: New Enterprise admins can let every team member use Grok Bot or limit it to specific groups with Group Access. Enterprise Enterprise admins can start a Grok Bot trial for their team from the dashboard, and Bot settings show when the trial ends. Enterprise When you approve a purchase, Pay with lets you choose a saved card from your Link wallet. Fixed Numbered lists keep their numbering when a paragraph sits between items, and line breaks in messages and tables show up. A chat that fails to load after a connection problem tries again on its own. When you're not on a team, Grok Bot follows your account's privacy setting. Moving a Bot into another sidebar section keeps it there. A notice tells you when routines were paused while you were away.

item.title: International typing and team setup (0.32.0)
item.description: Improved The team page offers Set up Grok Bot until your team turns it on, then links to a getting started guide and usage. Teams Fixed Typing on your Bot's computer follows your input method, so Korean, Japanese, Chinese, and accented letters come through as you composed them.

item.title: Onboarding, team invites, and HTML previews (0.31.0)
item.description: New Onboarding asks what you'll be working on most and suggests Bots for that kind of work. Team admins can invite their whole team to Grok Bot, or pick specific groups and members. Teams A Setup Checklist on the dashboard walks admins through plugins, Slack, GitHub, sign-in, and inviting teammates. Teams Opening an HTML file your Bot made shows a preview, with Source for the code, and links in it open in your browser. A Cloud Agent's open button lets you choose Open in Web or Open in Cursor, and remembers your choice. When a firewall or VPN blocks your Bot's computer, Grok Bot says it can't reach it and offers Retry. Improved You can create more than 50 Bots. Hourly, interval, and daily routines run on a schedule counted from when you create them. Fixed Files you attach and dictation stay with the Bot you started them in, even if you switch Bots. A Cloud Agent your Bot started isn't launched twice when a launch is retried, and your Bot hears when it finishes. On Linux, links that open Grok Bot launch the app. Images you attach show thumbnails on Windows.

item.title: Template sharing, Link purchases, and languages (0.30.0)
item.description: New Share a Bot as a template: choose whether your team or anyone can use it, and others add their own copy from the link. When your Bot wants to buy something, a card shows the amount for you to Allow or Deny, then Link completes the payment. Team admins choose whether members can share templates publicly or only within the team. Teams Action Recording on the dashboard records members' Grok Bot actions to your team's audit log. Enterprise Grok Bot is available in Arabic, Ukrainian, Dutch, Greek, Afrikaans, and Hebrew, with right-to-left layouts for Arabic and Hebrew. Command-Shift-V, or Ctrl-Shift-V, pastes text into the message box without formatting. You can approve a task on one computer from another computer where you're signed in. Enterprise usage settings show a Personal Usage chart of your spend against last month and your limit. Enterprise Improved Jump to lists matching Bots above actions and messages. Send Feedback lets you ask for a response. Fixed Pasting an image attaches it as a file, and the cursor stays in view after you paste a long message. Your Bot's browser switches to the tab it picks and reloads pages that fail to open.

item.title: Computers in Settings and phone replies (0.29.0)
item.description: New Settings has a Computer section listing your computers, where you choose Always allow, Ask every time, or Never allow for actions on each one. Notifications from the Grok app on your phone show your Bot's reply. Improved You can drag the details pane wider, up to the chat's minimum width. Fixed Your Bot's computer starts when you belong to more than one team.

item.title: Russian, Turkish, Italian, and Swedish (0.28.0)
item.description: New Grok Bot is available in Russian, Turkish, Italian, and Swedish, and follows your computer's language. Improved Settings and plugin links your Bot writes show the real name of the setting or plugin. Fixed Signing in stops waiting after five minutes, so you can try again.

item.title: Pro and SuperGrok access, and webhook data (0.27.0)
item.description: New Cursor Pro subscribers can now use Grok Bot, as can SuperGrok and X Premium+ subscribers who link their account. Improved Admin setup on the dashboard shows Enabled once your team finishes setting up Grok Bot. Teams Routines started by a webhook receive the request body, so your Bot can act on what was sent. Fixed If a chat can't load, Grok Bot says so and offers Retry.

item.title: App menu, right-to-left typing, and updates (0.26.0)
item.description: New The app menu has Settings…, Check for Updates, and Restart to Update when an update is ready. Improved Typing in Arabic, Hebrew, and other right-to-left languages starts on the right, and replies that mix directions lay out each paragraph correctly. Unread Bots appear first in the search palette. Update Grok Bot's Computer explains when an update only touches the software your Bots run on, so installed apps stay. Fixed Grok Bot uses the team you picked at sign-in the first time it loads your teams. Alerts, feedback, and About open on top of Settings. When an update is required, the Update required screen covers the whole window.

item.title: Multi-select questions and on-demand limits (0.25.0)
item.description: New When your Bot asks a question that allows several answers, select the ones you want and press Submit. On an individual plan, set your monthly on-demand limit to None, Fixed, or Unlimited in Usage & Billing. A GitHub routine can watch a single pull request, including when it closes, and removes itself once the pull request merges or closes. Download a diagram in the chat as a PNG image. Click a Bot mentioned in a conversation to open it. Improved When your included usage runs out, team members can upgrade to a Premium seat, alongside Ultra and SuperGrok Heavy. A Bot you delete disappears from the sidebar as soon as you confirm, and you're told if deleting fails. Fixed Text you paste into the message box stays plain, and anything you type right after sending is kept. Messages that start with a link show the rest of their text, and the link stays clickable. Grok Bot uses the team you selected for rules, Usage & Billing, and Computers, and switches to a team you can still use if yours is gone. Privacy Mode keeps a conversation off your Bot's computer when it must not be stored. Your Bot's computer finishes restoring its files, including ones with long names.

item.title: Setting links, team sign-in, and voice input (0.24.0)
item.description: New Hover a settings or plugin title and choose Copy link to share a direct link to it. Right-click a video and choose Save video… to keep it. If you belong to more than one team, sign-in asks you to pick one. Onboarding and the access screen show the email you're signed in with, with Log out. Improved Voice input detects the language you speak instead of assuming your app or system language. Sign out explains that it removes the account and its local data from this computer, and your Bots and chats return when you sign in again. Fixed Today and Yesterday update after midnight, and attachments stay on the day you sent them. Links into Grok Bot open the right page instead of only bringing the window forward. If you message your Bot while a routine is running, the routine runs again afterward.

item.title: Team setup and translation fixes (0.22.0)
item.description: Fixed Setting up Grok Bot on the dashboard uses the team you selected. Teams Spanish and French translations of plugin counts, routine schedules, and alert statuses read correctly.

item.title: App languages, emoji, and webhook routines (0.21.0)
item.description: New Pick the app's language under Appearance, including Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, and Polish. Type : in the message box to pick an emoji, or finish a short name with : to insert it. Routines can start from a webhook, with their own Webhook URL and Webhook key. Download an attachment from the message menu, or use Download all when a message has several. Enterprise admins can save Team Setup scripts on the dashboard that run on every member's Bot computer. Enterprise Enterprise admins can set a network access policy for their team's Bots from the dashboard. Enterprise Improved Dictation follows your system language, and Enter stops a recording. Updating or recreating your Bot's computer explains that files and logins stay while installed apps and packages are removed. Plugins opens with your plugins, category filters, and a Team Plugins section. Fixed Files search finds files on your Bot's computer, and says Search unavailable when it can't run. Grok Bot reconnects to your computer after sleep or a dropped connection, so actions on it keep working. When your sign-in expires, Grok Bot asks you to sign in again.

item.title: Dictation, formatting, and clearer errors (0.20.0)
item.description: New Press or hold ⌘D (Ctrl+D on Windows and Linux) to dictate into the message field, and Send message sends the transcript as soon as it's ready. Rename a plugin's default account with Edit default account. Improved Your Bot's computer can hold Shift, Ctrl, Alt, or Command while it clicks, drags, and scrolls. When a reply fails, Grok Bot explains what happened in plain language. Your Bot cancels, archives, and unarchives Cloud Agents as soon as you ask. Fixed Replies show underline, subscript, superscript, and highlight formatting.

item.title: Manage Plan, scrolling, and Bot naming (0.19.0)
item.description: New Settings has Manage Plan, showing the upgrade options for your account. When your included usage runs out, you can upgrade to Ultra or link a SuperGrok Heavy subscription. A Scroll to bottom button appears above the message field when you scroll up. Settings has Use hardware acceleration under General → System, on by default on a Mac, with Restart to Apply. Improved Settings, search, and confirmations say Bot instead of Agent. The message field stays at the bottom of the chat, even when the chat is empty. Start a computer update from Settings with Update Grok Bot's Computer. Requests to run a command on your computer hide the command until you choose Show the command. Fixed Help Center opens the Grok Bot docs. ⌘V pastes into a terminal on your Bot's computer. Allow, Never, and Deny now clear a stuck request to run commands on your computer.

item.title: Cancel Trial in Usage & Billing (0.18.0)
item.description: New You can end a free trial early with Cancel Trial in Usage & Billing, which removes any remaining trial credits.

item.title: More routine triggers and pull request links (0.17.0)
item.description: New Members with a Standard seat on a self-serve team can use Grok Bot through a linked SuperGrok Heavy subscription. Teams Improved Your Bot can create routines that start from a Microsoft Teams message, a Linear issue, a Sentry alert, or a PagerDuty incident. Auto-review asks before your Bot runs a task you didn't ask for. Pull request links open where you or your team chose, or on GitHub if neither has chosen. Fixed The account row in the sidebar opens the account menu, even during setup. Your Bot stops showing that it's working once a background task finishes. A connector that stops responding times out after three minutes, so your Bot can carry on. Update Grok Bot's Computer finishes and keeps file permissions and shortcuts. Choosing a shape or color keeps a picture you added until you press Set avatar.
